explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Winterthur" (revision 1379901103) says: "Although the forces involved were small, the ability of the Austrians to sustain their 11-hour assault on the French line resulted in the consolidation of three Austrian forces on the plateau north of Zürich, leading to the French defeat a few days later." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of Winterthur caused First Battle of Zurich, and nothing more.
